g.text: The sync work item publishes MAIN_PRIV_SYNC and reschedules itself every CONFIG_APP_SYNC_INTERVAL
seconds, so a trigger that arrives in STATE_SYNCING is dropped without stopping the timer.
A step that is not built is skipped, so the last built step returns to STATE_SYNC_IDLE.
Fuel gauge sampling is not part of these states. The Battery module samples on its own timer,
and BATTERY_PERCENT_REQUEST only reads the state of charge from its latest sample.
